name: msdfgen
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
summary: Command line tool and C++ library that builds single- and multi-channel signed distance field textures from vector shapes or font glyphs. Output is an image that a shader samples to render text or icons crisply at any scale. Its strength is sharp corners from MSDF where a plain SDF rounds them. The atlas generator msdf-atlas-gen is a separate repository.
use_when: Crisp resolution-independent glyphs or icons in WebGL, Three.js or game scenes via a shader
Preparing distance-field fonts when troika-three-text's runtime generation is not wanted
Offline, deterministic SDF baking in a build step
avoid_when: Text only needs to appear in a DOM or SVG scene: opentype.js or the browser
Three.js text with no pipeline: troika-three-text generates SDFs at runtime
A full multi-glyph atlas with metrics: use the separate msdf-atlas-gen
notes: 2026-10-26: the msdfgen CLI needs FreeType support for font input; whether the Homebrew bottle enables it was not verified.

assessment.rationale: Release v1.13 on 2025-11-30; repository pushed 2026-08-29; MIT. Niche but unique: no other record bakes MSDF textures. Atlas generation lives in a separate project.
